Claim 13 (Currently amended): A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides __integrated contact elements positioned externally on the connector__ by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising __an insulating sheathing body that thermally insulates the flexible tube__.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is removably attachable to the flexible tube __via a mechanical fastening mechanism__.

Claim 16 (Cancelled)

Claim 17 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein said sheathing body includes __a multi-layered design with at least one insulating layer__.

Claim 18 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is __a flexible tube with integrated heating capability__.

Claim 19 (Cancelled)

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein said second connector further includes __a separate pressure measuring tube connection port__.

Claim 21 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising __an optional respiratory gas humidifier module__.

Claim 22 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is adapted to be connected to a water source via __a dedicated humidification line__.

Claim 23 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is in the form of __a separate flexible tube piece that can be disposed between the breathing mask and the respiratory gas tube__.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from __a spirally reinforced plastic material that provides structural rigidity__.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is __an electrical resistance heating element__.

Claim 26 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element __is positioned to extend generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device__.

Claim 27 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each __contact element is provided within the second portion__.

Claim 28 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the first portion is __tubular in shape and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion__.

Claim 29 (Currently amended): A connector for connecting a CPAP device to a respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the respiratory gas tube arrangement including a heater, the connector comprising: a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage; and a second portion that provides __integrated contact elements positioned externally on the connector__ by which power is supplied to the heater, wherein each contact element __is positioned to extend generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device__.

Claim 30 (Currently amended): A connector according to claim 29, wherein each __contact element is provided within the second portion__.

Claim 31 (Currently amended): A connector according to claim 29, wherein the first portion is __tubular in shape and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion__.
